newsitem.title: USA: Wallace holders to vote share boost.
newsitem.headline: Wallace holders to vote share boost.

text.p: Wallace Computer Services Inc said Tuesday that shareholders at a special meeting on February 28 will be asked to approve an increase in the number of authorized common shares outstanding to 100 million from 50 million.

According to a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the additional shares will be available for any future needs of the company including stock splits, stock dividends, employee benefit plans and other purposes.
As of November 30, 1996, Wallace had 42,870,000 common shares outstanding.
Wallace makes and distributes information management products and services.
